capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Polestar US page: 111 kWh battery on all trims (does not say gross/usable); BatteryDesign.net and Motor1 give 111 total / 107 usable for this SPA2 pack.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: BatteryDesign.net (Polestar 3 filing): 111 kWh total / 107 kWh usable; EV Database MY23-25: 107 usable; Motor1: EX90 same pack 107 net.

chemistry.notes: BatteryDesign.net: NMC811, CATL, prismatic. Motor1: EX90 sibling pack is NMC from CATL.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: US owner manual says "Battery preconditioning automatically starts when a DC fast charging station is set in the built-in navigation app"; no manual control is mentioned, but the manual silence does not prove there is none.

dc_max_kw.notes: Polestar US page: DC fast charging peak 250 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Polestar US page: AC charging 11 kW (US market).
